ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high-intensity pixels are distributed as dense mottling across the distal regions of both lobes, while low-intensity pixels form a solid contiguous block at the central median notch and proximal peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region (surrounding the notch) consists of solid low-intensity pixels; distal lobes exhibit high-frequency white speckling and irregular blotches; high-intensity pixels form a concentrated band along the trailing edge of the left lobe (image-left).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 25% into the total vertical span of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by coarse, non-uniform serrations; prominent peaks are spaced 30-50 pixels apart on the outer lobes, interspersed with deep, jagged notches particularly visible on the image-left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, upward-swept terminal tips; the overall 2D profile follows an 'S-curve' from the notch to the apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity (white) circular pixel formations are visible at the extreme tips of both lobes, suggesting localized calcified buildup.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, white linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake-like markings) are visible crossing the dark pigmentation on the interior surface of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch/missing segment is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe roughly midway between the notch and tip; encrusted white formations are visible at the far right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy 'salt-and-pepper' mottle pattern localized specifically in the dark-pigmented zones of the inner lobes.
